Calculate the proportion as the number of trips that are part of a group divided by the total number of trips ending at that station.
sql:
-- Final query with proper formatting
WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    starttime,
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    DIV(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime), 2) as two_min_bucket
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    trip_date,
    two_min_bucket,
    COUNT(*) as bucket_size
  FROM same_station_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name, trip_date, two_min_bucket
),
group_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    s.start_station_id,
    s.start_station_name
  FROM same_station_trips s
  JOIN bucket_counts b 
    ON s.start_station_id = b.start_station_id 
    AND s.start_station_name = b.start_station_name
    AND s.trip_date = b.trip_date 
    AND s.two_min_bucket = b.two_min_bucket
  WHERE b.bucket_size >= 2
),
station_group_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id,
    start_station_name,
    COUNT(*) as group_trip_count
  FROM group_trips
  GROUP BY start_station_id, start_station_name
),
station_total_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id,
    end_station_name,
    COUNT(*) as total_ending_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id, end_station_name
)
SELECT 
  t.end_station_name as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_trip_count, t.total_ending_count) as group_ride_proportion
FROM station_total_counts t
LEFT JOIN station_group_counts g
  ON t.end_station_id = g.start_station_id
  AND t.end_station_name = g.start_station_name
WHERE g.group_trip_count IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY group_ride_proportion DESC
LIMIT 10
